hero.title: See what AI knows about you.
hero.subtitle: Enter your name and your email. We look up what's public about you — breaches, profiles, and what AI assistants say — and explain it plainly, in a report scored from 0 to 100.

how.title: How it works

how.step3Body: A score from 0 to 100, what's visible about you, why it matters, and what you can do.

legalStub.body: This text has not been written yet. It ships on Day 6, before the service opens to anyone. In short: the legal basis is your consent, we only process your name, your email and optionally your city, data is deleted after 30 days, and you can exercise your rights by writing to the contact that will appear here.

summary.breachesNone: Your email does not appear in any known breach.
summary.breachesOne: Your email appears in 1 known breach{pw}.
summary.breachesMany: Your email appears in {n} known breaches{pw}.
summary.breachesUnchecked: We couldn't check breaches this time.
summary.profilesNone: Searching your name shows no recognizable public profile.
summary.profilesOne: Searching your name shows 1 public profile.
summary.profilesMany: Searching your name shows {n} public profiles.
summary.brokers: Also, {n} site(s) that sell personal data list your name.
summary.searchFailed: The name search didn't work this time.

findings.breachPasswordTitle: Your email appeared in the {name} breach ({year}) with a password
findings.breachPasswordDetail: Leaked: {data}. If you still use that password anywhere, change it today and turn on two-step verification.
findings.breachTitle: Your email appeared in the {name} breach ({year})
findings.breachDetail: Leaked: {data}. Without a password the risk is lower, but your email circulates in lists used for spam and targeted scams.
findings.breachUncheckedDetail: The breach service didn't respond. Request the report again later.
findings.noBreachesDetail: Your email is not in any public breach recorded to date. Good sign; it doesn't mean it can't happen tomorrow.
findings.profileDetail: Shows up when searching your name: "{title}". Check what it shows to strangers (photo, city, job) and tighten privacy if needed.
findings.brokerTitle: A site that sells personal data lists your name ({host})
findings.brokerDetail: These sites collect phone numbers and addresses from public sources and sell them. It may be someone else with your name; if it's you, almost all have an opt-out form.
findings.pageDetail: On {host}. Check whether it's about you or someone else with your name.
findings.noResultsDetail: The search returns no recognizable profiles or pages. Low public exposure by name.
findings.searchFailedDetail: The search engine didn't respond. Request the report again later.

actionsTpl.changePasswordDetail: Start with {name}. If you reused that password, change it everywhere you used it.
actionsTpl.twoFactorDetail: On your email and your bank at minimum. With it, a leaked password isn't enough to get in.
actionsTpl.reviewProfilesDetail: Open your profiles as a stranger would and remove anything you don't want everyone to see.
actionsTpl.brokerOptOutDetail: Look for "opt out" or "remove my data" on each one. It's usually a two-minute form.
actionsTpl.passwordManagerDetail: A different password per site without memorizing them. It's the single measure that most reduces damage from future breaches.
actionsTpl.monitorDetail: New breaches appear every week. Repeat the report in a few months.
